description: This file defines a singleton class HeartbeatStore that manages and observes heartbeat events via NotificationCenter and async tasks. It decodes ControlHeartbeatEvent objects from notifications and initializes lastEvent with data from a control channel.

classes.name: HeartbeatStore
classes.description: A singleton observable class that tracks the last heartbeat event, observing notifications and fetching data asynchronously.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HeartbeatStore by setting up a notification observer and attempting to fetch the last heartbeat asynchronously.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes the notification observer when the instance is deallocated.
